title: 第23章 火热的呼吸烫进来第24章 不够就再抽一下
slug: 共梦后被顶级凶兽们亲哭了
lines: “那大姐，老黑在你来这里之前，给你联系了吗？”苏芽芽留了个心眼，“他没跟你说点啥吗？”
大姐一听这个，脸上的笑容一停。
“他就给我打电话说这里包吃包住，不在意年龄和学历，我……”大姐叹了口气，“我就来了，我没读过什么书，年纪也大，找别的工作也未必要我。”
“哦哦，反正在这有个老乡，也真是还不容易啊。”苏芽芽轻叹了一口气，暗暗搓了搓手指。
“是啊，对亏老黑经常提点我，”大姐往前看着，似乎陷入了回忆，“要不我几年也不好过。”
这话，但凡斗兽场的喽啰都知道是什么意思。
能在这里活几年，绝不是件容易的事。
这里不是凭借单纯老实就能侥幸苟活的地方。
“我的饭也热好了，我先过去了。”苏芽芽看到自己那锅冒起热烟，起身返回去。
“有什么我能帮忙吗？”半虎兽人一直端详着她的表情，“你好像有心事。”
“没有，”苏芽芽摆摆手，“我没什么事。”
半虎兽人还想说什么，苏芽芽的注意力已经转移给了锅。
透过透明锅盖，能看到水面微微漾起气泡。
还要再热两分钟，才可以。
苏芽芽就看着锅盖沿边溢出的热气，想着大姐说的话。
她虽然没有跟老黑直接接触过，后场地方也就这么多，她也见过他几次。
老黑一看就是人群里那种比较会来事的那种人。
是苏芽芽羡慕的那种聪明人。
跟谁都能说几句。
所以在整个后场几乎大家都没什么名字的时候，大家都默认叫他老黑这个外号，也算是独一份。
随着水温上升，水汽顶动锅盖，发出微微的响动。
苏芽芽正愣愣地看着抖动的锅盖，余光看到通道上走来几个人。
她转眼一看，丁管事正拧着眉看着她。
他旁边还有胖管事和另外两个眼熟的管事。
苏芽芽跟丁管事四目相对之际，就本能觉得皮紧。
不过她没做什么错事，她只是站起来冲管事们问好，“管事们好。”
“你们大厨又做什么饭呢，”胖管事揶揄丁管事，讥讽苏芽芽道，“你做了什么美味佳肴啊，让我们开开眼呗？”
“我没做什么。”苏芽芽苦笑着解释。
“装什么装，你都被副经理点名去主厨房做饭了，估计今天又做什么大菜了，”胖管事嗤笑一声，“怎么，好吃的舍不得叫我们看一眼啊？”
他越说，丁管事的脸色越不好，还拿眼瞪了苏芽芽一眼。
苏芽芽还记得他的警告，跟顶头上司对着干，能有什么好？
她赶紧把电源关掉，锅盖掀开，直接把冒着热烟的锅往他们跟前端过去。
胖管事斜着眯眯眼，看着她那口锅。
丁管事眉头皱着。
content_en:
"Sister, did Lao Hei contact you before you came here?" Su Yaya kept an eye on her, "Didn't he tell you anything?"
When the eldest sister heard this, the smile on her face stopped.
"He just called me and said that food and accommodation would be provided here. He didn't care about age or education. I..." The eldest sister sighed, "I'm here. I haven't read any books and I'm old. There's no need for me to find another job."
"Oh, it's not easy to have a fellow countryman here anyway." Su Yaya sighed softly and rubbed her fingers secretly.
"Yeah, it's a shame that Lao Hei always reminds me," the eldest sister looked forward, seeming to be lost in memories, "otherwise I wouldn't have had a good time in a few years."
Everyone in the Colosseum knows what this means.
It is by no means easy to survive here for several years.
This is not a place where you can survive simply by being honest.
"My rice is also hot, I'll go over first." Su Yaya saw the hot smoke rising from her pot, got up and went back.
"How can I help?" The half-tiger orc kept studying her expression, "You seem to have something on your mind."
"No," Su Yaya waved her hand, "I have nothing to do."
The half-tiger orc wanted to say something else, but Su Yaya's attention had already been transferred to the pot.
Through the transparent pot lid, you can see the bubbles rising slightly in the water.
It will take another two minutes to heat it up.
Su Yaya looked at the heat escaping from the edge of the pot lid and thought about what her eldest sister said.
Although she has not had direct contact with Lao Hei, there are only so many places in the backcourt, and she has met him a few times.
At first glance, Lao Hei seems to be the kind of person who is more trouble-making among the crowd.
He is the kind of smart person that Su Yaya envies.
I can have a few words with anyone.
So when almost no one in the entire backcourt had a name, everyone defaulted to calling him the nickname Lao Hei, which was considered his only one.
As the water temperature rises, the water vapor pushes up the lid of the pot, making a slight sound.
Su Yaya was staring blankly at the shaking pot lid, and from the corner of her eye she saw a few people walking down the aisle.
She turned around and saw Manager Ding looking at her with a frown.
Next to him were the fat steward and two other familiar stewards.
When Su Yaya and Manager Ding looked at each other, they instinctively felt their skin tightening.
But she didn't do anything wrong. She just stood up and said hello to the stewards, "Hello, stewards."
"What's your chef cooking?" Fat Steward teased Steward Ding, and taunted Su Yaya, "What kind of delicious food did you cook to open our eyes?"
"I didn't do anything." Su Yaya explained with a wry smile.
"Whatever you are pretending to be, you have been asked by the deputy manager to go to the main kitchen to cook. You are probably cooking something big again today," the fat steward sneered, "Why, it's so delicious that you don't want us to take a look at it?"
The more he spoke, the worse Manager Ding's face became, and he even glared at Su Yaya.
Su Yaya still remembers his warning, what good can she do if she goes against her immediate boss?
She quickly turned off the power, opened the lid of the pot, and moved the smoking hot pot directly towards them.
The fat steward squinted his eyes and looked at her pot.
Manager Ding frowned.
